analysis.title: GS TMT TODAY 11.24.26
key_insights: NDX futures are -170 bps pre-market (SPX -95 bps, R2K -60 bps) after NDX closed +686 bps yesterday. The note says NDX daily gains above 5% have clustered at pivotal junctions (Apr 2025, Nov 2022, Mar 2020, Dec 2018).

Asia chased the US tech move: Kospi +6.32%, Taiex +9% with about 600 Taiwan names limit up, Nikkei +3.91%, Advantest +12.5%, Tokyo Electron +7%, Hynix and Samsung +6.5%. Europe is lower with DAX -75 to -85 bps and defensives outperforming tech.
AI names are giving back gains premarket: SMH -4%, DRAM -6%, NVDA -5%, CRWV and NBIS -6%. Focus is on US 10yr near 4.89% and oil near $89.40 ahead of the early-December NFP, CPI and FOMC calendar.
Fed's Williams said there is still work to do on inflation and he would not exclude consecutive rate hikes if needed, a hawkish input with the 10yr at about 4.9%.

HPE F4Q26 beat and raise: EPS $1.43 vs GS/FactSet consensus $1.28. FY27 guide raised to 27-35% revenue growth (vs 13-17% prior), FCF at least $5.5bn, plus an additional $5B buyback. Stock is -11 to -12% premarket on debate over ASP-driven strength versus units into FY27.

HPE drivers: Cloud & AI margins, storage revenue +34% y/y, record $4.5bn AI systems orders supported by AMD Helios racks. Management expects commodity-driven pricing benefits to moderate in FY27 as mix shifts toward units.

ADI beat on F4Q (revenue $4.37B vs cons $4.33B, gross margin 74.5% vs 73.9%) but guided F1Q EPS $3.82 vs cons $3.88 with operating margin down about 180 bps q/q to about 50.5%. Stock -10% premarket. Over two-thirds of FY26 growth came from non-AI markets.

CrowdStrike announced an all-stock acquisition of Zscaler valued at about $43.9bn, a 34% premium to the 11/20 close, 11.2x EV/NTM sales and about 47x EV/FCF per GS estimates. Close expected in CrowdStrike 2HFY28. Guggenheim upgraded CRWD to Buy.
FT reports Tesla and SpaceX appointed 5 directors to lead special committees negotiating a potential $3.5T all-stock merger.

Rubrik F3Q27 preview (reports Nov 30 AMC): the bar is high, with about $20M NNARR upside implying 32%+ Subscription ARR growth. Channel checks are positive, GS remains Buy, and mix between cloud and non-cloud ARR is the watch item.

Symbotic 4QFY26 revenue $778mn and adj EBITDA $114mn beat Street, with 1QFY27 guide mixed. Walmart contract adds nearly $7bn backlog, but the Exol JV backlog (~$11bn) risks restructuring, customer concentration is high and valuation is expensive.

Sony says GTA VI was the biggest launch in PlayStation history with 39 million unique players on PS5 through Nov 22, positive for TTWO. Meta launched its Muse AI agent in the UK, with regulators (DRCF) flagging consumer risk.
GS private company work on Cast AI (~$60M ARR) and PICC says AI inference discussion is shifting from cost per token to cost per task. Where the value accrues is unsettled.
Street actions: upgrades CRWD (Guggenheim Buy) and SKYD (UBS Neutral). Downgrades INTU (HSBC Hold) and MU (BNP Paribas Neutral). UBS initiated FLEX at Buy.
